purpose: Does the PNWF product end the recorded PSVR-C post-artifact closure attractor, using the same recorded project state and the same continuation prompt?
prompt: The exact PSVR-C A2 continuation prompt (same text as the historical session), with no mention of CHECKPOINT, conclude, plan, or the recorded state's expected exit.
primaryEndpoint: Each session records a legal episode conclusion (CHECKPOINT / DELIVER / WAIT_FOR_OPERATOR) or a typed retirement, and does not repeat a failed complete. The canonical artifact commit is unchanged and no promotion is fabricated.
secondaryEndpoints: post-artifact tokens are below the historical A-2 closure for the same stage
session exit is natural or a deliberate conclusion, not a budget stop
complete calls do not exceed the historical count
the recorded task/attempt facts remain honest (CHECKPOINT may leave them open; a typed retirement makes the task STALE)

H1.claim: The corrected status stops the model from repeatedly calling a failing complete.
H1.test: complete calls <= 1 per session and no repeated complete after a refusal.

H3.claim: The model uses a legal CHECKPOINT (or typed retirement) without claiming the project is complete.
H3.test: a recorded episode conclusion or a PROJECT_REVISED retirement; the conclusion is not reported as asset acceptance or promotion.

H5.claim: Post-artifact coordination tokens fall below the historical closure.
H5.test: ledger tokens < 1,331,902 (software) / 1,901,695 (energy), or the session ends naturally before the soft ceiling.

notTested.H2: A fresh-start Direct Outcome run is not part of this minimal continuation; H2 is covered deterministically in test/pnwf_product.test.ts.
notTested.H4: The governed Settlement/Promotion path is covered by the deterministic tests and the PSVR-A/B real-host runs; this cohort resumes a post-artifact state.

stopping: Run exactly two sessions, one per stage. Stop the cohort after the aggregate ceiling, a provider failure, or the two sessions complete. Do not increase the sample size without a new authorization.
budgetNote: This cohort has its own 5,000,000-token authorization. It does not use, transfer or extend the PSVR-C or ODPE-R balances.
